# Haidarabbas Balospura

> AI/ML engineer and full-stack developer based in Gujarat, India. Builds production-ready LLM systems, fine-tuning pipelines, and autonomous agents.

This is a personal portfolio site with one main page and a free resume tailoring tool.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://haidarabbas.dev/): About, background, experience, projects, and contact
- [Resume AI](https://haidarabbas.dev/resume): Free tool that tailors a resume to a job description. It runs in the browser with the visitor's own API key

## Projects

- [Ragify](https://ragifyai.netlify.app/): A production RAG app for chatting with your own documents. [Source code](https://github.com/Haidarabbas731/Ragify)
- [Plan Generator](https://plan-generator.haidarabbas.dev): Turns a goal into a day-by-day study plan that is written block by block, with a chat to reshape it. [Source code](https://github.com/Haidarabbas731/Plan-Generator)
